name: palette-extractor
description: Extract a reproducible sampled sRGB palette from supplied artwork, read exact normalized pixels at explicit coordinates, and export CSS variables, GIMP GPL, JSON and swatch PNG in a ZIP. Choose 2–12 representative colors and an alpha threshold. Quantized cluster means are approximate; percentages describe included samples, not full-image area or official brand colors. Contrast checks assume opaque colors and pure black/white text, not a full accessibility audit. Inputs: JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 20 MB and 16 megapixels. Requires a connected account; exports are public.
